Definition: probably from G792; to flash as lightning:--lighten, shine.
BiblicalUsage: The Son of man will lighten like the lightning that shines from one part of heaven to the other, and the two men at the empty tomb stood in shining garments. The word is the flash itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the brightness at the tomb was the first flash of the resurrection morning, and the world has never been dark since.
